title: Product noise on the uniform sign cube
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $[0m\rho\in[0,1]$. On the cube $[0m\{-1,1\}^n$ with uniform measure, the product noise operator that retains each input sign with probability $[0m\rho$ and otherwise resamples an independent uniform sign agrees, on every real-valued function $f$, with the Walsh noise operator: it multiplies the Fourier coefficient indexed by a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ by $[0m\rho^{|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube
